note: S17.1 (the axis/sign transposition companion to move_line_slicing). The SAME slicing drag, transposed to the y-axis: h@600 full-span (id:1) over 1000x1000, dragged delta=-100. The drag axis is y (an h line slides on y, shrinking cell HEIGHT); the clamp filters incident to the frame_min_y==600 (lower) cell for delta<0. L.coord translates 600->500; NO perpendicular (v) endpoint rides (they anchor at canvas x-faces). Guards the v->x/h->y axis-keying + the sign-both-ways shrinking-side selection.
